description:
Variation of Condition 4 of permission ref: P2022/0933/FUL dated 16/06/2022 which sought consent for ‘change of use of 870sqm of flexible commercial (Class A1 / D1 use) floorspace at ground floor level to Class E floorspace.’ amendments seek to amend the wording of condition 4 to allow for a 24-hour use .

The site is located at 123 Farringdon Road, Islington, where Islington Local Plan (adopted in September 2023) provides policy guidance. Under the Islington Local Plan policy map, the site is allocated as Central Activities Zone (CAZ) (policy R3: Islington’s retail hierarchy – Central Activities Zone). This policy states that CAZ is the primary office location and that proposals in line with policy AAP1 (Bunhill and Clerkenwell Area Action Plan (AAP)) Prioritising office use will be supported. 

The existing condition no. 4, only allows LinkedIn to operate within the office between the hours 07:00 – 23:00. However, the Local Plan policies which are supportive of office use do not set out any time limitations within the CAZ. Additionally, our client’s site is surrounded by a mixture of commercial uses, including F&B operators, other offices and residential uses, including hotels.
